Patrick County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Beginner-Friendly Guide to Property Auctions

Patrick County, Virginia holds public tax sales to collect unpaid property taxes. These auctions help the county recover lost revenue and give buyers the chance to invest in real estate. If you’re thinking about bidding at a Patrick County tax sale, here’s what you need to know in plain language.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Patrick County Schedules Tax Sales

The county doesn’t hold tax sales on a set date each year. They only happen when enough properties qualify for auction.

  • Auction Frequency: As needed
  • How to Stay Informed: Check the Auction Calendar or the official tax sale page regularly

Auction Time and Location

Each auction has a unique schedule and venue.

  • Start Time: Listed in the official auction notice
  • Time Zone: Eastern Time (ET)
  • Location:
    • Most auctions are in person
    • Usually held at Patrick County Circuit Court
    • The notice confirms the address for each sale

Registration and Participation Requirements

You’ll need to register before you can bid.

  • Pre-registration Required: Yes
  • Registration Instructions: Included in the sale notice
  • Opening and Closing Dates: Vary with each auction—review the notice early
Click Here to Book a Call with Dustin Hahn

Understanding the Redemption Period

The original owner can still save the property—but only before auction day.

  • Before the Sale: Owners can redeem the property by paying all overdue taxes and fees
  • After the Sale: Redemption is no longer possible

How Bidding and Payments Work

Winning the bid means you must pay quickly and with approved funds.

  • Who Wins: The highest bidder
  • Deposit: Required immediately after winning
  • Final Balance: Due within the time frame listed in the auction terms
  • Accepted Payment Methods:
    • Money order
    • Cashier’s check
    • Certified funds
    • No cash or personal checks allowed

Where to Get Updates on Upcoming Sales

Stay current by visiting:

  • Patrick County Judicial Tax Sale Page – For upcoming sales and legal notices
  • TACS Website: taxva.com

Who to Contact for Help

Need answers or guidance? Contact the tax sale administrator:

  • Taxing Authority Consulting Services (TACS)
  • Phone: (804) 548-4429
  • Email: taxsales@taxva.com

Pro Tips to Succeed at a Patrick County Tax Sale

These tips can help you make smart decisions and avoid common mistakes:

Lots near the Blue Ridge Parkway carry unique appeal—get familiar with usage limits.

Many homes have older septic systems—budget accordingly.

Use county GIS maps to compare elevation and slope before making a decision.
